title: Biological Activity of Copper(II) and Palladium(II) Complexes with a Tetradentate S,O-Donor Ligand.
authors: Saric, Anita; Mitrovic, Marina; Barjaktarevic, Ana; Stevic, Snezana Jovanovic; Petrovic, Biljana; Milanovic, Ziko; Tomovic, Dusan Lj; Bukonjic, Andriana M; Petrovic, Djordje; Jakovljevic, Mirjana; Radic, Gordana P; Jovanovic, Marina; Corovic, Irfan; Zdravkovic, Nebojsa; Jovanovic, Ivan; Markovic, Bojana Simovic
one_liner_zh: 该文研究铜/钯配合物的抗癌活性及与DNA的次要沟槽结合，虽含分子对接但对象为小分子-DNA非TF-DNA体系，且无AI或MD方法，仅边缘相关。
abstract: New copper(II) (C1) and palladium(II) (C2) complexes with S,O-tetradentate ligand (L) derived from thiosalicylic and thiopropionic acids were synthesized. In cell-based assays, (C1) exhibited the most pronounced activity within the tested compound series and was therefore advanced for mechanistic evaluation in 4T1 triple-negative breast cancer cells. (C1) significantly reduced 4T1 cell viability by inducing early and late apoptosis, accompanied by mitochondrial membrane depolarization and enhanced cytochrome C release. Consistently, (C1) increased the Bax/Bcl-2 ratio, promoting a pro-apoptotic shift. In parallel, (C1) triggered autophagy, as evidenced by decreased p62 and LC3B levels, induced G0/G1 cell-cycle arrest, and suppressed proliferative signaling by downregulating Ki67, cyclin D, and phosphorylated AKT. The DNA-binding studies showed moderate to strong affinity, favoring minor groove binding, with higher affinity for (C1) than for (C2). Tryptophan fluorescence quenching indicated a strong interaction with BSA via a predominantly static mechanism, more pronounced for (C1). Molecular docking at the DNA and BSA binding sites corroborated experimental findings and suggested favorable interactions between the complexes and apoptosis-related proteins (CASP3, BAX, and BCL2). The integrated experimental and computational data identify (C1) as a biologically active compound with multimodal biological effects in vitro, supporting further structural optimization and mechanistic investigation.
abstract_zh: 合成了由硫代水杨酸和硫代丙酸衍生的S,O-四齿配体（L）的新型铜(II)（C1）和钯(II)（C2）配合物。在细胞实验中，（C1）在测试化合物系列中表现出最显著的活性，因此被推进用于4T1三阴性乳腺癌细胞中的机制评估。（C1）通过诱导早期和晚期凋亡显著降低4T1细胞活力，伴随线粒体膜去极化和细胞色素C释放增强。一致地，（C1）增加了Bax/Bcl-2比率，促进促凋亡转变。同时，（C1）触发自噬，表现为p62和LC3B水平降低，诱导G0/G1细胞周期阻滞，并通过下调Ki67、细胞周期蛋白D和磷酸化AKT抑制增殖信号。DNA结合研究表明中等至强亲和力，偏好小沟结合，且（C1）的亲和力高于（C2）。色氨酸荧光猝灭表明与BSA主要通过静态机制发生强相互作用，且（C1）更为显著。在DNA和BSA结合位点的分子对接验证了实验发现，并提示配合物与凋亡相关蛋白（CASP3、BAX和BCL2）之间存在有利相互作用。综合实验和计算数据将（C1）确定为具有体外多模式生物效应的生物活性化合物，支持进一步的结构优化和机制研究。
